raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Serve `perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v1-0.6b` (architecture `PPLXQwen3Model`) as an embedding model.

```bash
python -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v1-0.6b \
  --is-embedding \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --attention-backend flashinfer \
  --disable-radix-cache \
  --chunked-prefill-size -1
```

## Modifications

1. `PPLXQwen3Model` subclasses `Qwen3ForCausalLM` and sets every attention layer to `ENCODER_ONLY`. The checkpoint's `modeling.py` sets `is_causal = False` on every layer.
2. It pools with `PoolingType.MEAN`. The checkpoint's `1_Pooling/config.json` sets `pooling_mode_mean_tokens: true`. The `LAST` pooler inherited from `Qwen3ForCausalLM` gives cosine 0.20 to 0.81 against the real embedding.
3. `EntryClass` registers both `Qwen3ForCausalLM` and `PPLXQwen3Model`.
4. `test/registered/prefill_only/test_pplx_embedding.py` compares SGLang against the HF bidirectional mean-pooled output on 4 prompts and requires cosine > 0.999. It fails on the last-token pooler (min cosine 0.198) and passes with this PR (37 s on B300).

`--dtype bfloat16` is required. The checkpoint config says `float32`, and `--dtype auto` downcasts float32 to float16. In float16, 3 of 8 test texts return NaN embeddings, and a batch of 8 on flashinfer returns NaN for every text.

## Accuracy Tests

Reference: `AutoModel.from_pretrained("perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v1-0.6b", trust_remote_code=True, dtype=torch.bfloat16)`, then the mean of `last_hidden_state` over all tokens, one text at a time. There are 8 texts: the 5 from the model card, 2 short QA texts, and one 401-token text. The runs use B300, transformers 5.19.0, the server command above, and this branch with main `14ad64c411` merged in.

| SGLang build | Pooling | Cosine vs HF, min | Cosine vs HF, mean |
|---|---|---|---|
| `b50bbd33c1` (before) | last token | 0.1984 | 0.4918 |
| `66ae01d638` (this PR), batch of 8 | mean | 0.9966 | 0.9995 |
| `66ae01d638` (this PR), one request per text | mean | 0.9973 | 0.9996 |

- 7 of the 8 texts are at 0.9998 or higher. The minimum is the 401-token text.
- The cosine between HF bf16 and HF fp32 is 0.9999 on every text, including the 401-token one.
- `--attention-backend triton` is within 0.0001 of flashinfer on every row.
- Cosine vs the checkpoint's int8 output (`round(tanh(x) * 127)`) is 0.9969 to 0.9996. Cosine is the metric the model card specifies.

Regression test:

```bash
python3 test/registered/prefill_only/test_pplx_embedding.py
```

## Follow-ups

- Mean pooling in `pool_hidden_states` runs `cumsum` in the model dtype across the whole batch. That is a candidate cause of the 401-token gap. It is not changed here.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

         self.model.layers_to_capture = [val + 1 for val in layer_ids]
 
 
-EntryClass = Qwen3ForCausalLM
+class PPLXQwen3Model(Qwen3ForCausalLM):
+    """perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v1: Qwen3 with bidirectional attention and mean pooling."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.pooler = Pooler(pooling_type=PoolingType.MEAN, normalize=True)
+        for layer in self.model.layers:
+            if isinstance(layer, Qwen3DecoderLayer):

+EntryClass = [Qwen3ForCausalLM, PPLXQwen3Model]

@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.engine import Engine
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+MODEL = "perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v1-0.6b"
+PROMPTS = [
+    "Scientists explore the universe driven by curiosity.",
+    "Children learn through curious exploration.",
+    "What is the capital of France?",
+    "Paris is the capital and most populous city of France, with an estimated population of 2 million residents.",
+]
+
+
+def hf_mean_pooled(prompts):
+    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL, trust_remote_code=True)
+    model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
+        MODEL, trust_remote_code=True, dtype=torch.bfloat16
+    ).cuda()
+    embeddings = []
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for prompt in prompts:
+            inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt").to("cuda")
+            hidden = model(**inputs).last_hidden_state[0].float()
+            embeddings.append(hidden.mean(dim=0).cpu())
+    del model
+    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+    return torch.stack(embeddings)
+
+
+class TestPPLXEmbedding(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_matches_hf_bidirectional_mean_pooling(self):
+        """SGLang embeddings must match the checkpoint's bidirectional mean-pooled output."""
+        expected = hf_mean_pooled(PROMPTS)
+        engine = Engine(
+            model_path=MODEL,
+            is_embedding=True,
+            trust_remote_code=True,
+            dtype="bfloat16",
+            disable_radix_cache=True,
+            chunked_prefill_size=-1,
+            mem_fraction_static=0.3,
+        )
+        try:
+            actual = torch.tensor([out["embedding"] for out in engine.encode(PROMPTS)])
+        finally:
+            engine.shutdown()
+        similarity = torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(actual, expected, dim=-1)
+        self.assertGreater(similarity.min().item(), 0.999, similarity.tolist())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
